CFB-week.summary: Light midweek MAC slate: Buffalo at Ball State (Buffalo about a 3-point road favorite, total near 51.5), Sacramento State at Central Michigan, and UMass at Toledo (Toledo -14.5, total 51.5). Player prop markets were thin; only the two home quarterbacks' passing-yard lines turned up on a page that names the book. Buffalo's packet QB, Elijah Holmes, is out for the season after knee surgery; Jason Wright has been the starter.

NBA-BOS-at-TOR-1112.summary: Toronto is shorthanded: Scottie Barnes (groin) is out, Kawhi Leonard (knee) and Nate Bittle (foot) remain out, and Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Collin Murray-Boyles (illness) are questionable. Boston has no listed injuries and is about a 7-point road favorite with a total near 216. Ball-handling and usage shift toward Barrett, Walter and Shead.

NBA-SA-at-CHI-1112.summary: Spurs are without Tobias Harris (calf) and Devin Vassell (groin) is questionable after missing Monday. Chicago's Norman Powell is questionable with back spasms after sitting out Nov 8 with a shoulder issue; Zach Collins (illness) and Tobe Awaka (back) are also questionable. Buzelis is healthy but his rebounds line fell a full point from open without a clear reason.

NBA-WSH-at-IND-1112.summary: Indiana is still without Haliburton (hamstring), Sheppard (knee surgery) and Furphy. McConnell, the stand-in starting point guard, is questionable Wednesday with a strained hamstring, so Nembhard could see more ball-handling if he sits. Oubre has just come back from a calf issue. Washington is missing Vukcevic, Champagnie and Beekman, all depth pieces.

NFL-WAS-at-NYG-1113.summary: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) was full in practice Tuesday and Harbaugh expects him to be a fully cleared, although the feed still shows him as out. That makes Singletary a backup again. J.J. McCarthy (hip pointer) is also expected to start. Washington is still without McLaurin (IR) and Croskey-Merritt (IR, groin), leaving White and Ekeler to share the backfield. Burks is questionable. Both red-zone defenses rank near the bottom of the league, and rain with gusty wind is forecast.

SOCCER-day.summary: De Bruyne, Kane, Fabián Ruiz and Cucurella are all in their national squads for the Nov 12 Nations League games with no injury flags; Kane is England's only senior striker besides Calvert-Lewin. Aydın's November call-up and starting role could not be confirmed, and no November Croatia team news was found for Sučić.

fix.summary: Quick availability checks for tonight's Top 10 NBA picks: Barnes is out and Quickley is questionable for Toronto, Powell is questionable for Chicago, and the Spurs, Pacers and Grizzlies picks are not on injury reports.

NBA-BOS-at-PHI-1111.summary: Both teams' rotations are close to intact. Boston listed no injuries, and Philadelphia ruled out only bench big Adem Bona (neck sprain) and Dominick Barlow (back), so the Sixers' starting five is healthy. Embiid is not on the report, but the team is still managing his right-foot plantar fasciitis. He was capped at 25 minutes on Nov 2 and has sat the second game of back-to-backs; tonight is not a back-to-back for Philadelphia.

NBA-MIA-at-UTAH-1111.summary: Utah (1-9, eight straight losses) is without Keyonte George (ankle), Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic, and Lauri Markkanen is questionable with a re-aggravated wrist sprain (Josh Green starts if he sits), pushing creation to rookie Darryn Peterson. Miami lists only Giannis (probable, wrist) and moved Pelle Larsson into the starting five over Andrew Wiggins on Sunday.

NBA-MIL-at-NY-1111.summary: Both teams list only one player: Josh Hart (right ankle soreness) is questionable for New York after missing two straight games, and Tyler Herro (right knee contusion) is questionable for 1-9 Milwaukee. Hart's status decides whether Landry Shamet keeps his fill-in starting role or returns to the bench.

NBA-OKC-at-POR-1111.summary: Oklahoma City (8-2, four straight wins) remains short-handed: Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace, Sorber and now Jaylin Williams (low back spasms) are out, keeping the offense heavily on Gilgeous-Alexander, who is not on the report. Portland (6-3) is without Ja Morant, Shaedon Sharpe and Vit Krejci.
